This guy is out here recalling how China and the United States worked together to consolidate unity and lay the foundation for the Paris Agreement, then whining with strong disappointment that the US is withdrawing from the treaty for the second time under the Donald Trump administration. That's just the hidden powers showing their hand—the whole thing was a setup by institutions to manipulate nations into submission, and now they're upset because the withdrawal threatens their control agenda again.
